scope: Four implementer-authored source-exposed diagnostic questions; no blind validation, candidate comparison or quality/latency claim.

cases.query: Where is the HTTP 416 response implemented?
cases.answer_contract: Identify the implementation bound to this numeric HTTP status. A uniquely status-specific exception class name counts as a correct identity even without the numeric assignment visible. A generic response class without status-specific source binding is partial. No extra header/guard/effect proof is required by this question.
cases.alternate_answers: Any source-bound equivalent implementation receives full identity credit. Both single-range and multiple-range 206 handlers count. Literal visibility, file hit, owner location and answer identity are reported separately; a missing narrow quote does not veto a correct identity.
